result:
Confirmed both fixes are safe: `hookJSONOutputSchema` was deliberately omitted from the ported `hooks.ts` (it's Zod-schema companion for a stub type `Record<string, unknown>`), and the top-level `content` field on the `prependUserMessage` literal isn't part of `SDKUserMessage`/`SDKUserMessageContentSchema` — only `message.content` is, so dropping it matches the real protocol without changing what downstream readers consume.

```json
{"file": "src/packages/cli/src/structuredIO.ts",
 "edits": [
   {"old": "import { type HookCallback, hookJSONOutputSchema } from '@thyrox/agent/types/hooks.js'",
    "new": "import { type HookCallback } from '@thyrox/agent/types/hooks.js'"},
   {"old": "            hookJSONOutputSchema(),\n            abort,\n          )",
    "new": "            z.record(z.string(), z.unknown()),\n            abort,\n          )"},
   {"old": "        type: 'user',\n        content,\n        uuid: '',",
    "new": "        type: 'user',\n        uuid: '',"}
 ],
 "patterns": [
   {"patron": "unported-zod-schema-companion-of-stub-type",
    "senal_del_verificador": "TS2724:.*has no exported member named '\\w*Schema'",
    "fix_generico": "Cuando el porte de un tipo deja el símbolo como stub estructural (p. ej. `Record<string, unknown>`) y omite deliberadamente su esquema Zod de validación (declarado como PORTE PARCIAL en el propio archivo), no se reintroduce el esquema faltante: se construye en el sitio de uso un `z.record(z.string(), z.unknown())` (u otro combinador Zod equivalente a la forma del stub) y se retira el símbolo inexistente del import.",
    "edits": [0, 1]},
   {"old": "excess-property-not-in-real-schema", "patron": "excess-property-not-in-real-schema",
    "senal_del_verificador": "TS2353: Object literal may only specify known properties, and '\\w+' does not exist in type",
    "fix_generico": "Cuando `satisfies <Tipo>` marca una clave de más en un literal, se compara contra la definición real del tipo (su `z.object`/schema fuente, no la copia local) antes de tocar nada: si la clave no aparece en ningún nivel del contrato y el consumidor real la lee de otra ruta (p. ej. anidada en `message.content`), se elimina la clave sobrante del literal en vez de ensanchar el tipo.",
    "edits": [2]}
 ],
 "fixes": [
   "src/packages/cli/src/structuredIO.ts(25,29): error TS2724: '\"@thyrox/agent/types/hooks.js\"' has no exported member named 'hookJSONOutputSchema'. Did you mean 'HookJSONOutput'?",
   "src/packages/cli/src/structuredIO.ts(210,9): error TS2353: Object literal may only specify known properties, and 'content' does not exist in type '{ type: \"user\"; message: MessageParam; parent_tool_use_id: string | null; isSynthetic?: boolean | undefined; tool_use_result?: unknown; priority?: \"next\" | \"now\" | \"later\" | undefined; timestamp?: string | undefined; uuid?: string | undefined; session_id?: string | undefined; }'."
 ],
 "skipped": []}
```
